name: Ticket booking
description: Booking a reserved train seat from start to finish: route, time, seats and payment on stepping stones, a running summary beside them, and the ticket with a tear-off stub at the end.

props.name: defaultRoute
props.description: Station ids where the journey starts and ends: otaru, chikko, asari, zenibako, hoshimi, inazumi, teine, kotoni or sapporo. Book another journey returns to it.

props.name: defaultPassengers
props.description: Passengers to start with, from 1 to 4. The seat step asks for one seat each.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root. It is at least the height of the viewport and the page scrolls. Going back through the steps, by the Back button or by a finished stone, keeps every choice; changing the route or date clears the train and seats that no longer fit. Also accepts every other div attribute.
